summary: Lolo NF lookout on Gold Peak, built 1914 and rebuilt in 1920 and 1928; the D-6 cupola cabin was destroyed in 1955 and the site is listed as gone.

facts.design: Pole tower with cab; D-6 cupola cabin from 1928 per firelookout.com
facts.status_note: Cabin destroyed in 1955; no source describes what remains on the peak

notes_for_editor: Height: the record's 18.3 m (60 ft) matches only the Missoulian's August 1922 description; firelookout.com gives a 38-ft pole tower (1914) and a 30-ft pole with 8x8 cab (1920), so the height of the structure that stood at the 1955 end is not known. The 1924 observatory item and firelookout.com's 1928 D-6 cabin date conflict; both are given. Staffing 'seasonal' is from 1922 only. The photo entry uses the Montana History Portal record page as its URL because the direct image URL was not captured; fetch the image file from that record before publishing it. The record's elevation is null; firelookout.com gives 7088 ft. The Forest Lookouts page quotes more Missoulian items (1922-1934) than the story uses. No access information found.
